info.title: Elaro API
info.summary: Headless intelligence broker: ingest, version and re-serve public telemetry.
info.description: All configuration is done through this API. Reads of data are open on the local network; all writes and settings reads require the admin bearer token printed on first start. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC. `/v1` is additive-only once released.

tags.name: Sources
tags.description: Upstream feed catalogue, subscription (enable/disable), budgets, credentials, health and diagnostics

tags.name: Records

tags.name: Changes

tags.name: Tiles

tags.name: Triggers

tags.name: Alerts

tags.name: Webhooks

tags.name: System

get.description: Catalogue of every available adapter with its settings, live health status and today's budget use.
Machine-readable health for every source; intended for monitoring and the adapter-maintenance agent.

put.description: Enable/disable (subscribe/unsubscribe), set interval, params, budget and retention. Changes apply immediately. Omitted fields are unchanged.
Write-only. Values are encrypted at rest and never returned by any endpoint.

delete.description: Also disables the source if it requires credentials.

post.description: Runs one fetch immediately and ingests normally. Consumes budget. Works whether or not the source is enabled (credentials permitting).

409.description: Already running, credentials missing, or in backoff

post.description: Fetches once and returns the raw upstream response (truncated) plus parsed records. Stores nothing. Consumes budget. Streaming sources capture for `seconds`.

parameters.name: maxBytes
parameters.description: Truncate raw body to this many bytes

get.description: Kinds currently present, with current-record counts and contributing sources.
Latest version of each record. Expired (validUntil passed) and tombstoned records are excluded unless requested.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter by source id (repeatable or comma-separated)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text match on searchable fields (name, title, callsign, place)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor

get.summary: Get current version of a record
All versions in a time range (playback)

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter by source id (repeatable or comma-separated)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor

get.description: Every new record version in commit order. `seq` is gap-tolerant but strictly increasing in commit order, so `after=<last seq>` never misses a change.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter by source id (repeatable or comma-separated)

get.description: Server-Sent Events. Event types: `change` (data = Change JSON, id = seq), `heartbeat` (every 15 s), `reset` (client buffer overflowed; resume via /v1/changes). Replays from `Last-Event-ID` / `after` before going live.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: SSE resume: last seq (changes) or alert id (alerts) received

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter by source id (repeatable or comma-separated)

get.description: Mapbox Vector Tile. `layer` is a kind (e.g. aircraft) or a source id. Feature properties: source, externalId, kind, observedAt plus the source's tileProperties.

post.summary: Dry-run a rule against stored data
post.description: Evaluates the rule over versions ingested since `since` without creating alerts or applying cooldown.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter by source id (repeatable or comma-separated)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor

get.description: Event types: `alert` (data = Alert JSON, id = alert id), `heartbeat`. Replays from Last-Event-ID.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: SSE resume: last seq (changes) or alert id (alerts) received

put.description: Omit `secret` to keep the existing secret.

post.description: Synchronously POSTs a synthetic alert and reports the result.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor

put.description: Replaces retention settings. Takes effect on the next retention run (hourly) or immediately via /run.

get.description: Source settings, retention, CORS, trigger rules and webhooks (without secrets/credentials).

put.description: Applies a bundle produced by export. Rules and webhooks are upserted by id. Unknown source ids are reported, not fatal.

post.description: Invalidates the current token and returns a new one exactly once.

credentialsSet.description: True if credentials are stored (values never returned)

SourceSettingsUpdate.description: Partial update; omitted fields unchanged. retention=null reverts to global default.

mode.description: match: fire on every matching version. enter: fire when a record's version satisfies the rule and its previous version did not (or it is new). exit: fire when the previous version satisfied the rule and this version does not. Edge modes evaluate geofence and conditions together.

TriggerRuleInput.description: All conditions are ANDed. geofence must be Polygon or MultiPolygon. At least one of source, kind, conditions, geofence is required.

adminToken.description: Admin token printed once on first start; rotate via /v1/system/admin-token/rotate.
